bias.zh: 回调 · 失守 $501，测试 $496.5 低点

read.en: Microsoft fell 2.0% on Nov 19 to $498.30, trading $498.16–526.49, its lowest close since Sep 24. It is below the 5-day ($510.9), 10-day ($520.8) and 30-day ($528.0), all falling, and above the 100-day ($485.8) and 200-day ($443.2), both rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($556.67), and RSI is 39.2, its lowest in 20 sessions.
read.zh: 微软 11月19日下跌 2.0%，收于 $498.30，盘中区间 $498.16–526.49，为 9月24日以来最低收盘。股价位于 5 日（$510.9）、10 日（$520.8）和 30 日均线（$528.0）下方，三者均在下行；位于 100 日（$485.8）和 200 日均线（$443.2）上方，两者均在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$556.67），RSI 为 39.2，为 20 个交易日最低。

read.en: The $526.49 high faded to a close near the low, breaking the $501–505 support, now resistance; the Nov 17 low ($496.51) held. Resistance is $501–505, then $506.2–510.9 (Nov 17–18 closes, 5-day) and $518–521 (Nov 16 close, 10-day). Support is $496.5, then $485.8–486 (100-day, Sep 10 low) and $477.2 (Aug 18 low). A close above $505 would target $508–511; below $496.5, $486.
